services.name: Half Harbor Ride
services.desc: Board an authentic Venetian gondola Rates Gondola Ride (price includes two passengers): $100, $25 for each additional passenger up to 6 total Children ages 5 and under ride free! Duration 1 Hour About On this one-hour excursion, guests can expect to board an authentic Venetian gondola and tour just over half of the beautiful Gig Harbor waterfront. A few of the main sites on this ride include the Old Ferry Landing, the Gig Harbor Lighthouse and the oldest home in Gig Harbor. All of our gondola rides are private.
